requirements.statement: Exact C008/T002 identity, pin mapping, logic levels, power, grounding, polarity, direction behavior, and termination shall be source-backed and physically measured before field operation.
The receive path shall preserve every observed RS485 byte and expose loss/error counters without being blocked by networking or logging.
Framing shall use only configured gap, delimiter, verified length, or diagnostic raw-chunk boundaries and shall not infer payload meaning.
Raw TCP and WebSocket fan-out shall be bounded and read-only by default; a slow or inbound client shall not block RX or cause UART writes.
Configuration shall use validated two-slot generation and CRC semantics and recover to the previous slot or a TX-disabled safe default after interruption or corruption.
The local UI and API shall expose only device-derived state, preserve stale values as stale, bound inputs, and meet the defined keyboard/mobile accessibility contract.
UART transmission shall remain zero unless authentication, CSRF/Origin, physical arm, expiry, budget, rate, idle, state, payload, and queue gates all pass.
Baud scanning shall be passive, evidence-based, deterministic, score zero-byte candidates as zero, and restore the original UART configuration on every exit path.
Every mutation, WebSocket handshake, and OTA upload shall authenticate and validate origin/nonce before first-body or first-upload-byte side effects, with bounded inputs and secret redaction.
OTA shall verify Ed25519 manifest, board ID, size, SHA-256, inactive slot, boot health, and rollback; invalid or interrupted images shall never become valid.
A release shall satisfy the 72-hour soak, zero-loss/reboot/overflow gates, heap and latency budgets, reproducible artifacts, SBOM, recovery runbook, and explicit TX profile decision.
